extraction.name: CONTEXTUAL
extraction.description: A novel benchmark dataset consisting of 506 human-crafted instructions that require context-sensitive joint reasoning over textual and visual elements in text-rich images across eight real-world visual scenarios: time reading, shopping, navigation, abstract scenes, mobile application usage, web usage, infographics, and miscellaneous natural scenes.
extraction.creator: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng
extraction.citeAs: Wadhawan, R., Bansal, H., Chang, K.-W., & Peng, N. (2024). CONTEXTUAL: Evaluating Context-Sensitive Text-Rich Visual Reasoning in Large Multimodal Models. In Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2024), PMLR 235.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were sourced from six distinct sources: keyword search via CLIP-retrieval UI on LAION-5B for Time, Shopping, Navigation, and Abstract categories; Rico dataset for Application Usage; web scraping links from the Open WebText Initiative for Web Usage; InfographicVQA test set for Infographics; and STVQA and ESTVQA test sets for Miscellaneous Natural Scenes. Images underwent manual filtering or heuristic-based filtering using PaddleOCR (selecting the top 500 images with highest word count), followed by author instruction-response annotation and MTurk verification.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Web Scraping, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: LAION-5B, Rico Dataset, Open WebText Initiative website screenshots, InfographicVQA test set, STVQA test set, and ESTVQA test set.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images categorized under Time, Shopping, Navigation, and Abstract underwent manual filtering for annotation suitability. Images under Application Usage, Web Usage, Infographic, and Miscellaneous Natural Scenes underwent heuristic-based filtering using PaddleOCR to select the top 500 images with the highest number of words, from which a subset was annotated.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: In Stage 2, authors divided into two groups, each creating <image, instruction, response> triplets following guidelines ensuring instructions required context-sensitive joint reasoning over textual and visual cues. In Stage 3, Amazon Mechanical Turk workers verified the correctness of each sample (finding 96% correct), incorrect samples were filtered, and author groups cross-reviewed the annotations to produce 506 final instances.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: MTurk workers verified sample correctness, finding 96% of the samples were annotated correctly. Incorrect samples were filtered out, followed by a cross-review between the two author groups to filter low-quality samples and ensure guideline adherence.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Human annotators providing baseline responses and evaluations were mainly from the US.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: A subset of 100 samples from the 506 is released as a validation set along with reference responses, while reference responses are kept hidden for the remaining 406 samples. A leaderboard with recent LMMs is continuously updated.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The authors ensured images, instructions, and reference responses are not offensive to any social group, and no apparent harmful or privacy-sensitive information was observed.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Aids in evaluating multimodal AI systems for real-world assistive tasks, such as interpreting text-rich scenes (e.g., navigating maps in public spaces) to assist the visually impaired.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Annotators establishing the human baseline were mainly from the US, which may introduce geographic or linguistic bias in writing styles.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Model responses may hallucinate; human baseline and evaluations may reflect linguistic styles of US annotators rather than globally diverse populations.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking, evaluation, and validation of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) and Augmented Large Language Models on context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning.
